entry.intro: Cribbage for two to five players, with computer players to fill any empty seat.

leaveConfirm: A computer player takes your seat if you leave.

lobby.share: Share this code (click it to copy the invite link). Every seat must be filled (add computer players if you like) before the host starts.

deal.2: Two players: six cards each, two to the box.
deal.3: Three players: five cards each, one card each to the box, and one more from the deck.
deal.4: Four players: five cards each, one card each to the box.
deal.5: Five players: five cards each, one to the box, but the dealer is dealt only four and adds nothing.
